records.title: A Backside Post-Plant Nanoswarm from A
records.description: From the corner shown on A, line your crosshair up with the horizontal wall seam. Use the first throw, aimed perpendicular to the large A marking, to place a Nanoswarm in the demonstrated A Backside plant area. Match the stance and release from the original clip, then activate the swarm after a plant there.

source.author: Mary247hard
source.evidence: Tracker identifies this as a Killjoy Abyss attack guide for A Backside and Bridge. The clip description says to start from a corner, align to the horizontal wall line, and use two throws: first perpendicular to the A marking, then to its right. The original 27.3-second Tracker-hosted clip was viewed at the A-side stance and both landing areas. Riot patch notes through 13.08 show no Abyss geometry update to the demonstrated A locations; compatibility is inferred from these unchanged landmarks. Source reviewed; not tested in a live match.
source.rightsBasis: The community clip remains linked to its original Tracker guide page. No video, image, thumbnail or screenshot was copied or rehosted.

records.title: A Bridge Post-Plant Nanoswarm from A
records.description: From the same A-side corner, use the horizontal wall seam as your alignment and shift the second throw to the right of the A marking, as shown in the clip. The Nanoswarm lands on the demonstrated Bridge plant area. Reproduce the release reference shown and activate it after the Spike is planted there.
